description: Pilot POD-NN sweep at N = 512 (r = 48, N_T = 240, float64), stopped by decision (follow-up 4) after the production resolution was fixed at N = 1024. Only the first 6 of 24 planned runs (n = 4000, lambda_R in {1, 0.1}, seeds 0-2) had started; none finished. Validation metric: median rigorous reduced-certificate bound eta_aug on validation30 with the old rC:2x2 cells. Not evaluated further.
planned_design: 2 data sizes (800, 4000) x lambda_R in {0, 1e-2, 1e-1, 1} x seeds {0,1,2}, 2000 epochs, Adam 1e-3 cosine to 1e-5, batch 64
